component.name: WoW Addons from GitHub
component.summary: Update your WoW addons from repositories you choose, and nowhere else

description.p: Bind each installed World of Warcraft addon to the place its updates should come from -- a GitHub repository, or a folder on your own disk -- and update them all in one click.
It contacts exactly the hosts named in your own manifest and nothing else. There is no catalogue, no account and no telemetry of any kind.
